entries.en: These trousers have deep pockets and plenty of room at the knees.
entries.zh: 这条长裤口袋很深，膝部也很宽松。

entries.en: The researchers compared the genome of this plant with that of its wild relative.
entries.zh: 研究人员把这种植物的基因组与其野生近缘种的基因组作了比较。

entries.en: A wooden walkway lets visitors explore the rainforest without trampling young plants.
entries.zh: 一条木栈道让游客能够探索雨林，而不踩踏幼小的植物。

entries.en: I felt rather antisocial that evening and stayed home with a book.
entries.zh: 那天晚上我不太想与人来往，就待在家里看书。

entries.en: The editor preferred unjustified text because the uneven right edge looked less formal.
entries.zh: 编辑更喜欢未两端对齐的文本，因为参差的右边缘显得不那么正式。

entries.en: We had to reschedule the workshop when the meeting room flooded.
entries.zh: 会议室被水淹后，我们不得不重新安排研讨会的时间。

entries.en: The course includes hands-on training with the same tools used in local workshops.
entries.zh: 这门课包含实际操作训练，使用的工具与当地作坊所用的相同。

entries.en: The online booking system shows which seats are still available.
entries.zh: 联网订票系统会显示哪些座位仍可预订。

entries.en: The organiser moved the outdoor concert indoors after checking the weather forecast.
entries.zh: 组织者查看天气预报后，把室外音乐会移到了室内。

entries.en: The shop charged twenty pence for a small paper bag.
entries.zh: 这家商店一个小纸袋收费二十便士。

entries.en: Her new laptop computer fits easily into the small bag she carries to class.
entries.zh: 她的新膝上型电脑可以轻松装进她上课时背的小包里。

entries.en: The building has separate bins to make recycling easier for everyone.
entries.zh: 这栋楼设置了分类垃圾箱，方便大家进行回收再利用。

entries.en: An interdisciplinary team of historians and engineers studied the old bridge.
entries.zh: 一个由历史学家和工程师组成的跨学科团队研究了这座古桥。

entries.en: The exhibition explores how people build communities and friendships in cyberspace.
entries.zh: 这个展览探讨人们如何在网络空间建立社群和友谊。

entries.en: The database checks the uniqueness of each username before creating an account.
entries.zh: 数据库在创建账户前，会检查每个用户名的唯一性。

entries.en: A brief glitch in the signal appeared as a spike on the screen.
entries.zh: 信号中一个短暂的异常脉冲在屏幕上显示为尖峰。

entries.en: The advertisement's misrepresentation of the room size disappointed several guests.
entries.zh: 广告对房间面积的不实描述让几位客人感到失望。

entries.en: The village draws water from an aquifer beneath the surrounding fields.
entries.zh: 这个村庄从周围田地下面的含水层取水。

entries.en: The committee had been riven by disagreements long before the chair resigned.
entries.zh: 早在主席辞职之前，分歧就已使委员会分裂。

entries.en: Grandpa keeps a notebook full of sketches from his travels.
entries.zh: 爷爷保存着一本笔记本，里面画满了他旅行时的速写。

entries.en: The factory will retool its assembly line to make electric bicycles.
entries.zh: 工厂将重新装备装配线，用来生产电动自行车。

entries.en: The newspaper declined to publish an unsubstantiated claim about the missing funds.
entries.zh: 报社拒绝刊登一则有关资金失踪的未经证实的说法。

entries.en: The museum displayed a prototypical engine beside the later production model.
entries.zh: 博物馆在后来量产的型号旁展出了一台原型发动机。

entries.en: The island's desalination plant turns seawater into water for local households.
entries.zh: 岛上的脱盐厂把海水处理成供当地家庭使用的水。

entries.en: Each supplicant waited outside the palace for a chance to address the ruler.
entries.zh: 每位恳求者都在宫殿外等候，希望有机会向统治者陈情。

entries.en: The old workshop stored potash in a sealed container beside the furnace.
entries.zh: 那间旧作坊把钾碱存放在炉子旁的密封容器里。

entries.en: The novel questions whether the infliction of punishment ever changed the prisoner.
entries.zh: 这部小说质疑，施加惩罚是否曾改变过那名囚犯。

entries.en: Data compaction reduced the space needed to store the archive.
entries.zh: 数据压缩减少了保存这批档案所需的空间。

entries.en: The radiology seminar included a discussion of discography and spinal imaging.
entries.zh: 这场放射学研讨会讨论了椎间盘造影术和脊柱影像检查。

entries.en: The textbook uses coloured diagrams to explain the stages of embryological development.
entries.zh: 这本教材用彩色示意图解释胚胎发育的各个阶段。

entries.en: As a telecommuter, Maya joins the morning meeting from her home office.
entries.zh: 作为一名远程工作者，玛雅在家中的办公室参加晨会。

entries.en: The project requires more computing power than our old server can provide.
entries.zh: 这个项目所需的计算能力超出了我们旧服务器的供给能力。

entries.en: Volunteers arranged a beach clean-up after the storm left rubbish along the shore.
entries.zh: 风暴把垃圾留在岸边后，志愿者组织了一次海滩清理活动。

entries.en: The members voted to re-elect their chair for another year.
entries.zh: 成员投票决定让主席连任一年。

entries.en: They are staffing the new help desk with experienced volunteers.
entries.zh: 他们正为新服务台配备有经验的志愿者。

entries.en: The school inspectorate sent a team to observe lessons and interview teachers.
entries.zh: 学校督察机构派出一个小组，听课并访谈教师。

entries.en: The delay was caused by an unrelated problem at another station.
entries.zh: 延误是另一座车站一个无关问题造成的。

entries.en: We used last year's sales as a benchmark for measuring progress.
entries.zh: 我们用去年的销售额作为衡量进展的基准。

entries.en: The folders form a hierarchical structure, with individual projects grouped under departments.
entries.zh: 这些文件夹构成分层结构，各个项目归在部门之下。

entries.en: The planner took a holistic view of transport, housing, and public spaces.
entries.zh: 规划师从整体上考虑了交通、住房和公共空间。

entries.en: The recording captured a softly repeated mantra from the temple courtyard.
entries.zh: 录音记录了寺庙院子里轻声反复唱诵的咒语。

entries.en: The clinician asked about her symptoms before examining the test results.
entries.zh: 临床医师先询问了她的症状，再查看检查结果。

entries.en: The council plans to redesign the junction to make the crossings clearer.
entries.zh: 市议会计划重新设计这个路口，让人行横道更加醒目。

entries.en: An unexplained gap in the records made the sequence of events unclear.
entries.zh: 记录中一处未作解释的空白，使事件的先后顺序变得不清楚。

entries.en: The untreated timber gradually turned grey after several winters outdoors.
entries.zh: 未经处理的木材在户外过了几个冬天后，逐渐变成灰色。

entries.en: The mining exhibit explains how flotation separates valuable minerals from crushed rock.
entries.zh: 这个采矿展览解释了浮选如何从碎石中分离有价值的矿物。

entries.en: The biology diagram shows haemoglobin inside a red blood cell.
entries.zh: 这幅生物学示意图显示了红细胞内的血红蛋白。

entries.en: The new superstore sells furniture, groceries, and gardening equipment under one roof.
entries.zh: 新开的那家大型超级商店在同一栋建筑里销售家具、食品和园艺设备。

entries.en: Opening a bookshop remained her one unfulfilled ambition after retirement.
entries.zh: 退休后，开一家书店仍是她唯一尚未实现的抱负。

entries.en: The team used a supercomputer to model the movement of ocean currents.
entries.zh: 这个团队用超级计算机模拟洋流的运动。

entries.en: The government proposed to deregulate the industry after years of strict price controls.
entries.zh: 在多年严格控制价格后，政府提议解除对该行业的管制。

entries.en: I remained unconvinced by his explanation because the dates still did not match.
entries.zh: 我仍不相信他的解释，因为日期还是对不上。

entries.en: The handover included the keys, maintenance records, and instructions for the alarm.
entries.zh: 移交内容包括钥匙、维修记录和警报器使用说明。

entries.en: The farmer planted soya in the field beyond the railway line.
entries.zh: 农民在铁路线那边的田里种了大豆。

entries.en: The experiment tested whether the ants followed a trail of pheromone.
entries.zh: 这项实验测试了蚂蚁是否沿着信息素留下的路径行进。

entries.en: Camomile grew beside the path, its small white flowers bright in the sun.
entries.zh: 洋甘菊长在小路旁，小小的白花在阳光下格外明亮。

entries.en: We cleared the chairs and boogied to swing music until midnight.
entries.zh: 我们把椅子挪开，随着摇摆舞音乐跳舞，直到午夜。

entries.meaningZh: 驾车兜风取乐（常指未经车主许可）
entries.en: The teenagers were joyriding in a car they had taken without permission.
entries.zh: 那几个少年未经许可开走了一辆车，正在兜风取乐。

entries.meaningZh: 反射学（研究反射运动与过程的学科）
entries.en: The physiology lecture introduced reflexology through experiments on automatic muscular responses.
entries.zh: 生理学讲座通过有关肌肉自动反应的实验介绍了反射学。

entries.en: She made a patchwork blanket from cast-off shirts and old curtains.
entries.zh: 她用被丢弃的衬衫和旧窗帘做了一条拼布毯。

entries.en: The museum has a full-size model of the ship's original cabin.
entries.zh: 博物馆里有一个按原尺寸制作的船舱模型。

entries.en: We booked a non-stop flight so we would not have to change planes.
entries.zh: 我们订了直达航班，这样就不用转机了。

entries.en: The shares fell slightly as profit-taking followed a week of steady gains.
entries.zh: 股价在连续一周稳步上涨后，因获利了结而略有回落。

entries.en: The documentary examines the privatization of the railway and its effect on commuters.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片探讨了铁路私有化及其对通勤者的影响。

entries.en: The lecture traced how globalization changed the city's factories and shipping routes.
entries.zh: 这场讲座回顾了全球化如何改变这座城市的工厂和航运路线。

entries.en: Someone had illegally dumped a load of tyres beside the river.
entries.zh: 有人在河边非法倾倒了一车轮胎。

entries.en: The survey team promised confidentiality to everyone who agreed to be interviewed.
entries.zh: 调查团队向所有同意接受采访的人承诺保密。

entries.en: She chose a length of blue paisley to make a scarf.
entries.zh: 她选了一段蓝色佩斯利涡纹布来做围巾。

entries.en: The history class debated the reasons for the president's impeachment.
entries.zh: 历史课上，学生们讨论了总统遭到弹劾的原因。

entries.en: The appeals court upheld the earlier decision after reviewing the evidence.
entries.zh: 上诉法院审查证据后维持了先前的裁决。

entries.en: An offline copy of the map was useful when we lost our connection.
entries.zh: 网络连接中断时，地图的离线副本派上了用场。

entries.en: An interpretive panel beside the ruins explains how the building was used.
entries.zh: 遗址旁的一块解说牌解释了这座建筑过去的用途。

entries.en: A rabbit had bitten through the thin cord beside the garden gate.
entries.zh: 一只兔子咬断了花园门旁的细绳。

entries.en: A hacker gained access to the old server through an unused account.
entries.zh: 一名黑客通过一个闲置账户进入了那台旧服务器。

entries.en: This setting applies globally, so every open document uses the same font.
entries.zh: 这项设置在全局范围内生效，因此所有打开的文档都使用相同字体。

entries.en: The committee questioned the reasonableness of charging every visitor the same fee.
entries.zh: 委员会对向每位游客收取相同费用的合理性提出了质疑。

entries.en: The closeness of the weave made the fabric feel firm and heavy.
entries.zh: 紧密的织法使这块布摸起来结实而厚重。

entries.en: A micro camera inside the model recorded its journey through the tunnel.
entries.zh: 模型内的一台微型摄像机记录了它穿过隧道的过程。

entries.en: The sociology seminar examined how different societies define deviance.
entries.zh: 这堂社会学研讨课研究了不同社会如何界定越轨行为。

entries.en: The shelves leaned forward because the brackets had been installed improperly.
entries.zh: 由于支架安装不当，这些架子向前倾斜。

entries.en: She found a sense of tranquillity while sketching beside the quiet lake.
entries.zh: 她在宁静的湖边写生时，感受到了内心的平静。

entries.en: Please check the correctness of the totals before printing the report.
entries.zh: 打印报告前，请检查合计数是否正确。

entries.en: We chose these chairs for their durability rather than their appearance.
entries.zh: 我们选择这些椅子是因为它们耐用，而不是因为外观。

entries.en: Better transport increased the attractiveness of the area to new businesses.
entries.zh: 交通改善增强了这个地区对新企业的吸引力。

entries.en: Each attendee received a name badge and a copy of the programme.
entries.zh: 每位参加者都领到了一张姓名牌和一份活动安排。

entries.en: The title is centred horizontally between the left and right margins.
entries.zh: 标题在左右页边距之间水平居中。

entries.en: The radiologist compared the new mammogram with the image taken last year.
entries.zh: 放射科医生把新的乳房X线照片与去年拍的影像作了比较。

entries.en: The software offers an iconic interface with small pictures for common commands.
entries.zh: 该软件提供图标式界面，用小图形表示常用命令。

entries.en: Her diagram offers a clear conceptualization of the relationships between the three systems.
entries.zh: 她的示意图清楚地用概念形式表达了三个系统之间的关系。

entries.en: We are budgeting for new equipment before deciding how many machines to buy.
entries.zh: 我们正在为新设备编制预算，然后再决定购买多少台机器。

entries.en: A broadband connection allows several people to stream videos at once.
entries.zh: 宽带连接让几个人可以同时播放网络视频。

entries.en: The firm has a small team that handles conveyancing for house buyers.
entries.zh: 这家事务所有一个小团队，为购房者办理房产转让手续。

entries.en: The update improves the app's functionality by adding search and automatic saving.
entries.zh: 这次更新通过增加搜索和自动保存功能，提升了应用程序的功能性。

entries.en: Granddad taught me to mend a puncture before our first long bicycle ride.
entries.zh: 第一次长途骑车前，爷爷教我补破胎。

entries.en: The novel follows her journey from hopelessness to a cautious belief in the future.
entries.zh: 这部小说讲述了她从绝望走向对未来抱有谨慎希望的历程。

entries.en: The designer tested several compositional arrangements before fixing the pieces in place.
entries.zh: 设计师试验了几种组合布局，然后才把各部分固定到位。

entries.en: The programme encourages entrepreneurship by helping students develop and test business ideas.
entries.zh: 这个项目通过帮助学生构思和检验商业想法来鼓励创业。

entries.en: The film presents an idealized village where neighbours never argue.
entries.zh: 这部电影描绘了一个理想化的村庄，邻居之间从不争吵。

entries.en: The new assistant helped the solicitor manage a growing caseload.
entries.zh: 新助理帮助这位律师处理日益增多的案件。

entries.en: She intuitively chose the simpler explanation before checking the calculations.
entries.zh: 她在检查计算过程之前，凭直觉选择了较简单的解释。

entries.en: The server can process several requests concurrently without keeping users waiting.
entries.zh: 服务器可以同时处理多个请求，不让用户久等。

entries.en: The innkeeper refused to excuse the guest's rude behaviour as mere drunkenness.
entries.zh: 客栈老板不愿仅以醉酒为由原谅那位客人的粗鲁行为。

entries.en: The two models are structurally similar, although their outer cases look different.
entries.zh: 这两种型号在结构上相似，不过外壳看起来不同。

entries.en: The health textbook discusses masturbation in a chapter about human sexuality.
entries.zh: 这本健康教材在有关人类性行为的一章中讨论了自慰。

entries.en: The standardization of screw sizes made replacement parts easier to find.
entries.zh: 螺丝尺寸的标准化让替换零件更容易找到。

entries.en: The discovery of structural damage prompted a reassessment of the building's value.
entries.zh: 发现结构损坏后，人们重新评估了这栋建筑的价值。

entries.en: The archive's categorization of letters by decade makes historical research easier.
entries.zh: 档案馆按年代对书信分类，使历史研究更方便。

entries.en: A simple rearrangement of the desks created space for a reading corner.
entries.zh: 只需重新摆放课桌，就腾出了一个阅读角的空间。

entries.en: The service uses encryption to protect messages while they travel between devices.
entries.zh: 这项服务使用加密技术保护设备间传输的消息。

entries.en: Students complained about the unfairness of applying different rules to different classes.
entries.zh: 学生们抱怨，对不同班级采用不同规则是不公平的。

entries.en: The restored guildhall now houses an exhibition about the town's weaving trade.
entries.zh: 修复后的同业公会会馆现在举办有关该镇纺织业的展览。

entries.en: We moved the router upstairs to improve the wireless signal in the bedrooms.
entries.zh: 我们把路由器移到了楼上，以改善卧室里的无线信号。

entries.en: Some residents worried that commercialization would change the character of the annual festival.
entries.zh: 一些居民担心，商业化会改变这个年度节庆的特色。

entries.en: Her reinstatement as team captain was announced at the next practice session.
entries.zh: 在下一次训练时，球队宣布恢复她的队长职务。

entries.en: The resettlement programme helped families find homes after the valley was flooded.
entries.zh: 山谷被淹后，这项重新安置计划帮助各个家庭找到了住所。

entries.en: Adding the prefix un- changes the meaning of several adjectives in this exercise.
entries.zh: 在这道练习中，添加前缀un-会改变几个形容词的意思。

entries.en: Enter each month's expenses in a separate column on the worksheet.
entries.zh: 把每个月的支出分别填入工作表的一列中。

entries.en: She joined the museum on a six-month secondment from the university.
entries.zh: 她从大学借调到博物馆工作六个月。

entries.en: Please upload the photographs before you return the borrowed camera.
entries.zh: 归还借来的相机之前，请先上传照片。

entries.en: The researchers collected animal feces to study what the foxes had eaten.
entries.zh: 研究人员收集了动物粪便，以研究狐狸吃过什么。

entries.en: Having moved schools herself, she could empathize with the nervous new student.
entries.zh: 因为自己也转过学，她能体会那位紧张的新生的感受。

entries.en: His recklessness with borrowed equipment made the other climbers reluctant to trust him.
entries.zh: 他使用借来的装备时十分鲁莽，这让其他登山者不愿信任他。

entries.en: The distinctiveness of her voice made the song immediately recognizable.
entries.zh: 她声音的独特性让这首歌一听就能辨认出来。

entries.en: The quantification of water loss helped the engineers compare the two designs.
entries.zh: 对水损失的量化帮助工程师比较了这两种设计。

entries.en: The report examined how disablement affected access to work and public transport.
entries.zh: 这份报告研究了身体能力丧失如何影响就业和使用公共交通。

entries.en: The study explores the marginalization of rural communities in national debates.
entries.zh: 这项研究探讨了农村社区在全国性讨论中被边缘化的现象。

entries.meaningZh: 进入视野（用于hove into view）
entries.en: A fishing boat hove into view beyond the end of the pier.
entries.zh: 一艘渔船出现在码头尽头外的视野中。

entries.en: The institutionalization of regular elections changed how the association chose its leaders.
entries.zh: 定期选举的制度化改变了协会选择领导人的方式。

entries.en: The botanic garden keeps detailed records of where each specimen was collected.
entries.zh: 这座植物园详细记录了每份标本的采集地点。

entries.en: The firewall blocked an unexpected connection to the office network.
entries.zh: 防火墙阻止了一次对办公室网络的异常连接。

entries.en: The trial examined whether the company could be held criminally responsible.
entries.zh: 这场审判审查了是否可以追究该公司的刑事责任。

entries.en: The technician connected the gas analyser to a computer in the laboratory.
entries.zh: 技术员把气体分析仪连接到实验室的一台电脑上。

entries.en: The freeholder attended the meeting to discuss repairs to the shared entrance.
entries.zh: 永久业权持有人出席会议，讨论共用入口的维修问题。

entries.en: The detective found an incriminating message among the deleted emails.
entries.zh: 侦探在已删除的邮件中发现了一条显示涉罪的消息。

entries.en: The unpredictability of mountain weather forced us to keep our plans flexible.
entries.zh: 山区天气的不可预测性使我们必须灵活安排计划。

entries.en: The company will retrofit the old buses with more efficient lighting.
entries.zh: 公司将给旧公交车改装效率更高的照明设备。

entries.meaningZh: 社团主义（强调阶级或利益团体合作）
entries.en: The chapter examines corporatism through negotiations between unions, employers, and the state.
entries.zh: 这一章通过工会、雇主与国家之间的协商来研究社团主义。

entries.en: Travel writers sometimes romanticize village life and overlook its practical difficulties.
entries.zh: 旅行作家有时会把乡村生活浪漫化，而忽略其中的实际困难。

entries.en: It seemed heartless to cancel the celebration without telling the children why.
entries.zh: 取消庆祝活动却不向孩子们解释原因，显得很无情。

entries.en: The alto sang the opening phrase alone before the rest of the choir joined.
entries.zh: 女低音歌手先独自唱了开头的乐句，随后合唱团其他成员加入。

entries.en: The potter wore a blue smock covered with patches of dried clay.
entries.zh: 那位陶艺家穿着一件蓝色工作罩衣，上面沾着一块块干泥。

entries.en: She checked the scorecard before announcing the winner of the match.
entries.zh: 她核对记分卡后，宣布了比赛的获胜者。

entries.en: The editor suggested the excision of one paragraph that repeated earlier material.
entries.zh: 编辑建议删掉一段重复前文内容的文字。

entries.en: The proposal needed a seconder before the committee could discuss it.
entries.zh: 这项提案需要一名附议人，委员会才能进行讨论。

entries.en: A quiet weekend gave him time for introspection after the argument.
entries.zh: 争吵过后，一个安静的周末给了他自我反思的时间。

entries.en: A wallaby paused beside the track before hopping into the bushes.
entries.zh: 一只沙袋鼠在小路旁停了一下，随后跳进了灌木丛。

entries.meaningZh: 使永存于人们的记忆中
entries.en: The mural immortalizes the volunteers who rebuilt the town after the flood.
entries.zh: 这幅壁画让人们永远记住洪水过后重建小镇的志愿者。

entries.en: The intoxicating excitement of opening night kept the young actors awake.
entries.zh: 首演之夜令人陶醉的兴奋感让年轻演员们难以入睡。

entries.en: An indistinct figure stood at the far end of the misty platform.
entries.zh: 雾蒙蒙的站台远端站着一个模糊的人影。

entries.en: The ball ricocheted off the goalpost and rolled behind the goalkeeper.
entries.zh: 球撞上门柱后弹开，滚到了守门员身后。

entries.meaningZh: 追随乐队或歌星的狂热崇拜者
entries.en: A devoted groupie travelled to every concert on the band's final tour.
entries.zh: 一名忠实的乐队追随者奔赴了乐队最后巡演的每一场演出。

entries.en: He spoke huskily after singing for hours at the rehearsal.
entries.zh: 排练时唱了几个小时后，他说话的声音沙哑了。

entries.en: In the play, the villagers unite to challenge their cruel oppressor.
entries.zh: 在这出戏里，村民们团结起来反抗残酷的压迫者。

entries.en: The demographer studied how migration had changed the town's age distribution.
entries.zh: 这位人口统计学家研究了人口迁移如何改变该镇的年龄分布。

entries.en: Dad settled into the recliner with the newspaper and a cup of tea.
entries.zh: 爸爸拿着报纸和一杯茶，舒舒服服地坐进了躺椅。

entries.en: The director wanted warmth in the final scene without excessive sentimentality.
entries.zh: 导演希望最后一幕温暖感人，但不要过度煽情。

entries.en: An earthen wall enclosed the courtyard and sheltered it from the wind.
entries.zh: 一堵土墙围住了院子，为它挡风。

entries.en: She cinched the saddle firmly before leading the horse out of the stable.
entries.zh: 她把马鞍系牢后，才把马牵出马厩。

entries.en: The upriver villages receive their supplies by boat during the rainy season.
entries.zh: 雨季时，上游的村庄靠船运获得物资。

entries.en: The village headman welcomed the visitors and invited them to sit.
entries.zh: 村长欢迎来访者，并请他们坐下。

entries.en: The innkeeper left a lantern by the door for guests returning late.
entries.zh: 小旅馆老板在门旁留了一盏灯，方便晚归的客人。

entries.en: The memoir describes a young tribesman returning home after years in the city.
entries.zh: 这部回忆录描写了一位年轻的部落男子在城里生活多年后返回故乡。

entries.en: A cotton headband kept her hair away from her face during practice.
entries.zh: 训练时，一条棉质头带把她的头发拢住，不让头发遮住脸。

entries.en: An idealist at heart, he believed the rivals could learn to work together.
entries.zh: 他内心是个理想主义者，相信对手们能够学会合作。

entries.en: A pot of gumbo simmered on the stove while the guests set the table.
entries.zh: 客人们摆餐具时，一锅大杂烩浓汤正在炉子上慢慢煮着。

entries.en: The porosity of the stone allows rainwater to soak into it.
entries.zh: 这种石材的多孔性使雨水能够渗入其中。

entries.en: The fantasy novel sends its hero into the nether regions beneath the castle.
entries.zh: 这部奇幻小说让主人公进入城堡下面的地下区域。
